name: splicewire/laravel-beam-media
description: The media arm of the beam family: the generic UUID-native Media model (extends spatie/laravel-medialibrary's base Media with a uuid primary key), the declarative primary-image traits (HasPrimaryImages / HasFeaturedImage), and the ubiquitous, publish-only shared/ media table migration. Extracted from beam-core (HTTP-03 / ADR-0178): beam-media owns spatie/laravel-medialibrary and requires it DOWN. beam-media also requires base beam DOWN (HTTP-10, as a particle consumer) — a one-way edge; base beam does NOT require beam-media back, so there is no cycle. A host (Tower) subclasses Models\Media and binds it via config('beam-media.model').

package-topology.because: beam-media is the media arm of the beam family — it OWNS the media public surface (Models\Media, Data\MediaData #[ParticleResource], the download/ingest #[ParticleOp]s, the 2 traits HasPrimaryImages/HasFeaturedImage, the central+tenant media migrations) extracted DOWN out of beam-core (HTTP-03 / ADR-0178). As a particle CONSUMER (HTTP-10) it depends DOWN on base beam for the particle machinery, exactly as the sibling arms (accounts/bookmarks/taxonomy) do — a plain in-estate require modelled here as mustRequire, NOT a downOnly from-target: per the evaluator, downOnly lists the HIGHER tiers a package must never reach UP into (a downOnly entry flags when subject REACHES it), so listing beam there wrongly forbade the legal beam-media → beam consume-down edge. spatie/laravel-medialibrary is likewise a down-require (owned DOWN, see the require block) but lives OUTSIDE the topology include-globs (rushing/*, splicewire/*, schemastud/*), so it is asserted only in composer require — not as a topology rule (mustRequire/downOnly both key off the in-scope graph). The ADR-0178 invariant is one-directional: base beam does NOT require beam-media (no reverse edge → no cycle); the media-arm direction beam-media → beam is the natural, legal consume-down edge. beam-media must NEVER reach UP into the tower / satellite tiers it is consumed by (the policy.noRequire guards below), mirroring accounts/taxonomy.

noRequire.because: the media arm is reusable by any beam site; it is consumed DOWN by the tower host (which subclasses Models\Media + binds config('beam-media.model')) — beam-media never requires tower (no reverse/upward edge)
the foundation never reaches up into the consumer-app tier
